about: Ceilings for `check-editor-performance.py --budgets`: medians of a headless run, per action. Time ceilings are about 2.5x what a quiet machine measures, because machines differ; allocation ceilings are about 25% over the measured value, because allocation depends on the code and not on the machine. After a deliberate change, re-measure with `--budgets --measure` and lower or raise the number with the reason in the commit. Measured 2026-10-01: tab switch 1.0-1.5 ms and 132-203 KiB, interaction 0.9-1.7 ms, selection 2.3 ms.
